archive_intro.en: One row per finished Keel work item: its intent, spec and plan.

grade_block.en: Keel workflow: if this request is substantive work, make your first line `Grade: FULL — <reason>` or `Grade: LIGHT — <reason>`. FULL = end users or the production runtime consume the change (runtime code, schema, deploy/CI config, dependency versions, runtime config, user-facing text), even one line. LIGHT = only developers consume it (developer docs, local tooling, notes). Unclear → FULL and ask. FULL starts with the keel-intent skill; LIGHT: make the change, then run `{keel_wf} critic light --repo <repo> --request "<one line>"`. Pure questions need no grade.

work_hint.en: Open Keel work here: {path} ({status}) — read its intent.md to continue it.

approved_msg.en: The user approved {id} (hash {hash12}). Continue to the spec with the keel-spec skill.

nothing_awaits.en: Keel: nothing awaits approval under the name {name}.

ambiguous_slug.en: Keel: more than one work item named {name} awaits approval — type approve <YYYY-MM-DD>-{name}.

stale_intent.en: Keel: {id} changed after it was submitted — run critic intent and intent submit again, then approve.

submit_instruction.en: Read {path}. To approve, type exactly: approve {slug}

page_instruction.en: Approval page: {url} — the user can approve or request changes there; typing approve {slug} also works. If your tool can wait on a background command, run intent wait as the rules say, then end the turn.

page_fallback.en: The approval page could not start here. To use it, run in your own terminal: {keel_wf} review --work {work}

wait_approved.en: approved {id} (hash {hash12}). Continue to the spec with keel-spec.

wait_changes.en: changes requested: {note}. Edit the intent, run critic intent, then intent submit again.

wait_changes_bare.en: changes requested. Edit the intent, run critic intent, then intent submit again.

wait_timeout.en: still awaiting approval — end the turn; the user can still approve on the page, type approve {slug}, or run the review command. Do not act on approval yourself.

check_footer.en: Nothing was changed. To fix, reinstall from Keel's Workflow step (python3 app/server.py).
